answer: Conviction voting hardens influence only through continuously held stake: weight is the time-integral of capital left committed to one position, a saturating curve that climbs slowly and snaps to zero the instant funds move. Splitting one bankroll across 500 clones acts like a prism, fanning a single beam into many dimmer ones, each restarting at zero so their shallow curves sum to far less than one concentrated stake aged like jade. Capital that ebbs out on every tide never accrues weight, so a rented flash loan buys no votes.
